description: This file defines the SupervisorUserRole class within the OrangeHRM system. It manages user role permissions for supervisors, including accessing subordinate employee IDs, location IDs, and performance review IDs. It also handles quick launch features relevant to the supervisor's role.

classes.name: SupervisorUserRole
classes.description: A class representing the supervisor's user role, providing methods to retrieve accessible employee, location, and review IDs based on supervisor permissions, and managing quick launch features.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Provides singleton-like access to the LocationService instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Returns a list of accessible IDs for a given entity type such as Employee, Location, or PerformanceReview.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmployeeIds
methods.description: Retrieves subordinate employee IDs for the supervisor.

methods.name: getAccessibleLocationIds
methods.description: Retrieves location IDs associated with subordinate employees.

methods.name: getAccessibleReviewIds
methods.description: Retrieves performance review IDs for the supervisor's reviews.

methods.name: getAccessibleQuickLaunchList
methods.description: Returns the list of quick launch features accessible to the supervisor.
